name: CALQUENCE
indications_original: CALQUENCE is a kinase inhibitor indicated: • In combination with bendamustine and rituximab for the treatment of adult patients with previously untreated mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) who are ineligible for autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT). (1.1 ) • For the treatment of adult patients with MCL who have received at least one prior therapy. ( 1.2 ) • For the treatment of adult patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL). ( 1.3 )
contraindications_original: • Recommended dose is 100 mg orally approximately every 12 hours; swallow whole with water and with or without food. ( 2.1 ) • Advise patients not to chew, crush, dissolve, or cut tablets. ( 2.1 ) • Manage toxicities using treatment interruption, dose reduction, or discontinuation. ( 2.3 ) • Avoid CALQUENCE in patients with severe hepatic impairment. ( 8.6 )
